olfactōrĭŏlum , i, n. dim. olfactorium,
I.a little smelling-bottle, scent-bottle (postclass.): “olfactoriola vascula sunt muliebria, in quibus odoramenta gestantur,” Isid. Orig. 19, 31 ; Vulg. Isa. 3, 20, et Hier. in loc.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
